messages:
Kevin: Heads-up — Enterprise POC with FinCorp next week. They require strict EU-only data residency and want a clear map of subprocessors + failover behavior if EU is degraded. Can we confirm regions, routing policy options, and a cost delta? cc @maria
Maria: Quick clarifying q: do they want tenant-level pinning or per-request routing? That changes how we handle caches/KV.
Kevin: Tenant-level pinning. They also want the option to approve a US failover path in emergencies, not automatic. Also asking how pricing changes if we keep a warm standby in another region.
Alex: We have a routing policy called "region_pin" that binds a tenant to a region. For failover we support "region_fallback" which routes to a compatible model variant in the fallback region. I can extract the capacity & cost numbers.
Samir: Security question from their infosec: which subprocessors touch logs/telemetry for EU tenants? Also: do any logs ever egress to US? @legal_bot pls advise.
legal_bot: We can provide a subprocessors CSV + locations and certs. Hosted EU tenants use GCP europe-west1, logs/objects are stored in EU. Aggregated metrics are pseudonymized and may be replicated to US for analytics; we can opt-out for enterprise contracts via DPA. We'll include SOC2/SOC3 references.
infra_ops: Notes: for Private (VPC) we can ensure zero egress. For Dedicated, per-tenant routing rules are configurable in the control plane and we can pin to eu-west1 or eu-central1. Cost delta: rough +18% if you provision standby capacity in another region (amortized reserved GPU).
Kevin: Got it. Can you paste a sample routing config snippet I can show the customer?
Alex: Sure — example config we use internally:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "fincorp",
  "routing": {
    "primary_region": "europe-west1",
    "fallback": ["europe-west1", "us-central1"],
    "enforce_region_pin": true,
    "subprocessor_restrictions": ["no-us-logs"]
  },
  "model_policy": { "max_latency_ms": 120 }
}
```
Maria: I'll attach the subprocessors CSV and a line-item cost breakdown for hosted vs dedicated vs private. Kevin — do you want the DPA addendum draft included in the package?
Kevin: Yes please include the DPA draft and a one-pager on audit access. Also flag Dedicated/Private options with expected SLAs.
Samir: One more technical note for their question about embeddings: EU tenants' embeddings/indices are stored in EU-only indices. Cross-region read-replicas can be enabled only with explicit customer approval and are encrypted at rest and in transit.
legal_bot: I'll prepare the DPA addendum and subprocessors export and upload to the sales portal by EOD.
Kevin: Perfect — I'll update the POC plan and tell the customer we can provide: region pinning, an opt-in US failover workflow, subprocessor list, and a DPA addendum. Thanks all :tada:
